Sam: Quick capture from ten onboarding calls today. Consolidated signals below for product triage. Main asks: 1) one SSO mapping that's a renewal-at-risk, 2) per-route cost breakdown (customers want hourly/daily CSVs), 3) a reusable onboarding checklist (Notion template requested), 4) embedding freshness indicator for batch jobs, 5) clearer quota errors during trial bursts. Dropping compact rows + suggested next steps.
Rina: Can you put the renewal risk first and paste the minimal CSV?
Sam: Sure. Mini-rows:```customer_id,issue,prio,notes
meridian-44,SSO mapping,P0,IdP sends 'mail' but mapping expects 'user.email' -> login 401; renewal in 12 days
starlit-9,per-route-cost,P1,wants hourly + daily CSV exports and an API endpoint for route-level billing
orchid-2,checklist,P1,enablement asks for a Notion + printable single-page checklist (auto-fill tenant info)
cobalt-7,embed-freshness,P2,observed stale embeddings; ask for last_refresh timestamp and reingest hook
nebula-5,quota-ux,P3,trial user hit 429 RATE_LIMIT with unclear guidance
```
Omar: I'll take per-route cost. Proposed CSV fields: route_id, route_label, interval_start, interval_end, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_name, est_cost_usd. I'll open spike PROD-2197 and attach sample query.
Priya: I'll own the Notion checklist template + a simple JSON schema so DevEx can auto-populate customer name and initial routes. ETA Wednesday.
Sam: Meridian SSO: flagged as blocking_renewal in CRM. Priya, please DM IdP trace and mapping table. If it's blocking renewal, escalate to eng-oncall with a 48h SLA.
Rina: Pasting small IdP snippet (sanitized) and the row in CRM.
eng-oncall: Acknowledged CS-2110 "SSO mapping - meridian-44". Will try reproduce and aim to respond within 48h.
Sam: For embedding freshness, propose a small Console UX: show "last_refresh" per-tenant + a yellow staleness banner if older than 24h, with a button to request reingest. Omar, include a webhook on completion in the spike.
Omar: Yep. I'll include last_refresh_ts, reingest_action, webhook_url in the API contract. Posting initial SQL to #analytics by EOD.
Priya: For quota 429 message, can we change text to: "Usage exceeded trial quota. Contact CS or upgrade to continue. Request ID: <id>" and include a help link? That should reduce confusion. I'll file a small UX change ticket.
Sam: Also recommend adding intake columns in the sheet: "blocking_renewal", "impact_score (1-10)", "customers_reported", "first_seen". That helps PMs in Monday triage.
intake-bot: Created ticket CS-2110 and linked to thread. PROD-2197 opened for per-route cost spike.
Rina: I'll compute #customers_reported for per-route-cost this quarter and post numbers by lunchtime.
Sam: Great. I'll consolidate rows into product-intake, link CS-2110 + PROD-2197 + Priya's checklist PR when ready, and surface top-3 in the weekly PM sync. Thanks all :pray:
